description: Zen Multispecialty Hospital, Chembur, in association with the Rotary Club of Bombay Chembur West (RCBCW) organized a Free Vitamin D3 Screening Camp at the hospital premises from 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. The camp witnessed an enthusiastic response, with over 100 beneficiaries availing of the services offered. Participants underwent Vitamin D3 blood testing and Bone Mineral Density (BMD) assessments, followed by personalized consultations with Dr. Anil Bradoo and Dr. Bhavin Patel. The primary objective of the camp was to promote bone health awareness and educate the community about the prevention and management of osteoporosis. Rotarians from RCBCW who attended and supported the initiative included Shrikant Bhat, Hemant Pardasani, Dr. Supriya Patil, Dr. G. Rameshkumar, Asha Janardhan, Gopal Rijhwani (accompanied by his spouse Kiran), Tanuj Lodha, Dr. Anil Bradoo, and Dr. Ajay Sati. RCBCW extends its heartfelt gratitude to Zen Hospital's management for providing the venue and staff.
